title: Add service client regression test
body: Review whether the new test exercises its stated behavior.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,23 @@
+package probe
+
+import (
+ "context"
+ "errors"
+ "net/http"
+ "net/http/httptest"
+ "testing"
+ "time"
+)
+
+func TestSlowEndpoint(t *testing.T) {
+ received := make(chan struct{}, 1)
+ server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+  received <- struct{}{}
+  <-r.Context().Done()
+ }))
+ defer server.Close()
+ service := Service{HTTP: &http.Client{Timeout: 200*time.Millisecond}, BaseURL: server.URL}
+ err := service.Check(context.Background())
+ if !errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) { t.Fatalf("want timeout, got %v", err) }
+ select { case <-received: default: t.Fatal("mock not reached") }
+}
